title: Stop event data
description: Data of the events hold.set, hold.released and hold.expired: every stop transition publishes an event and writes an audit record (HLD-1, spec/lifecycles/hold.md). Metadata only: id, scope, effects, reason, deadline and author.

scope.description: Stop scope: a kind from the closed list spec/model/holds.yaml, the tenant and the name of the scope object. The farm scope has no tenant and no name; the tenant scope has no name.

name.description: Name of the scope object: role, task type, worker id, plugin, action, channel, machine, resource, bot group, bot, seat, schedule or case.

effects.description: Stop effects from the closed list spec/model/holds.yaml (kind: effect); pause_action since v0.2.

until.description: Stop deadline, or null: until released.

author.description: Stop author; for code stops inside a tenant the author contain_auto is written in the author_kind field.

released_by.description: Who released the stop; only for hold.released.
